decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - REASON

The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 17th August 2004 the proposed rear extension at 113 Ash Grove, Heston, would not be lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The development does not fall within Class A Part 1 Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the cubic content of the resulting building would exceed the maximum permitted development volume of 50 cubic metres, for development to a terraced dwelling.

A planning application for the proposed development will therefore be required.


INFORMATIVE

A revised application with scaled dimensions matching the annotated dimensions may qualify for the issue of a certificate.  If submitted within one year it would not attract a further application fee.
description: Certificate for lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
